text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert to ashwin: high GPU queue growth in customer-private-vpc cluster (sev2). Escalation path triggered.
ashwin: I'm oncall, joining bridge now. pinging infra.
michelle: customer-rep says inference latency 10s+ and a lot of 503s. Our console shows queued requests spiking.
jessie: observed queued_requests = 482 on cluster private-vpc-nyc, node_pool=gpuprod-pool-1. active_gpus=28, desired_nodes=32, max_nodes=32 (hpa hitting limit).
kyle: autoscaler shows ScaleTargetRef desired=32 -> max=32. It never requested new nodes because provider API returned quota_exceeded on last attempt. See snippet from autoscaler: ``ERROR calling provider: quotaExceeded: cannot allocate 4 more instances``
samir: Also seeing repeated image pull backoffs on new nodes: `ImagePullBackOff: nettimeout` — new nodes are slow to become ready which is compounding queue.
nashwin: Reassigning roles: michelle, run customer comms. jessie, confirm exact error on cloud provider API logs. kyle/samir, try manual node launch and check image pre-pull. I'll coordinate fallback routing options.
michelle: Messaged customer ops: "we're investigating, mitigation in progress, may route traffic to hosted fallback for affected models". Customer asked for ETA.
jessie: provider logs: 2026-03-15T13:12:41Z provider-api: allocateInstances failed: QuotaExceeded (region gpu-1) -> request_id=abc-123. This matches autoscaler.
kyle: Manual attempt to create node failed with same quota error. Workaround: we can register a reserved node from spare pool in us-east but that requires infra approval.
samir: While provider quota is fixed, we can temporarily enable overflow-routing to Hosted API for this customer's model. That will reduce queue and avoid dropping requests. Suggest toggling route policy to "fallback:hosted" for customer tenant id=acct-73.
nashwin: Proceed with overflow toggle. jessie, give me the exact route command.
jessie: `POST /v1/routing/policies/acct-73?action=patch` payload: ``{"fallback":"hosted","max_hosted_rate":50}`` — I'll apply and monitor.
(5m later) jessie: applied fallback; routing rule active. queued_requests dropped from 480 -> 120 within 6 minutes. latency for newly routed requests is within SLO at hosted tier.
michelle: Updated customer: "We've temporarily routed traffic to a hosted fallback while we resolve provisioning. No data was lost; we will revert when private capacity is healthy." Customer acknowledged.
pagerduty-bot: :white_check_mark: Acknowledgement recorded for incident ID INC-2026-0315-42.
kyle: Infra has approved borrowing 2 reserved GPUs from shared pool in us-east; provisioning now. Manual node creation logs show node bootstrap started.
samir: Pre-pull image job kicked off to avoid ImagePullBackOff once nodes become ready.
(20m later) ashwin: New nodes are Ready. Autoscaler target increased to 36 temporarily to absorb backlog. Observed queued_requests falling to single digits.
michelle: Customer reporting normal response times now. Marking customer impact reduced.
nashwin: Root cause summary to write: provider quota exhaustion + slow node bootstrap (image pull backoffs) prevented autoscaler from satisfying desired replicas, hitting max_nodes limit. Primary mitigations: enabled fallback routing to hosted, borrowed reserve GPUs, manual pre-pull of images, raised temporary max target.
jessie: Filing post-incident ticket with runbook links and recommended guardrails: 1) alert when HPA==max for >5m with queued>100, 2) pre-warm image cache on reserved pool, 3) add provider quota monitors. Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-gpu-capacity
ashwin: Handoff to daytime oncall samir for follow-ups and RCA. I'll start draft RCA. If anything regresses, ping paging again. :thumbsup:
